decisions.reason: As a core-adjacent formwork line with multiple models and initially strong prominence, it likely meets or exceeds aspiration levels by now, so a growing Mittelstand firm would retain it.
Because it supports the firm's automation and integrated-system strategy, management would keep it unless results clearly fell below aspiration, even if it remains a less prominent niche offering.

This shuttering magnet block line is closely related to established formwork business and can complement system sales, so it is still worth carrying while performance appears acceptable relative to aspirations.

After several years, this narrower magnetic formwork component still looks the most vulnerable relative to aspiration levels, and the earlier withdrawal of similar items makes reallocating resources to stronger core and new development projects more likely.
